signal: Trackforce appointed Scott Kaine CEO in January 2026 to accelerate global growth and partnered with AI surveillance firm Scylla

email.body1:
Armando, saw Trackforce brought on Scott Kaine as CEO to accelerate global growth and partnered with Scylla on AI threat detection.

A growth push usually means more inbound and in-market accounts than an SDR team can follow up with fast enough, so good leads cool while reps research and write. Our AI SDR drafts and follows up autonomously, so response speed and follow-up volume scale without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Armando, quick follow-up for Trackforce.

Most SDR teams lose deals to slow first touches and thin personalization, not bad lists, and that bites hardest when leadership is pushing for growth. The fix is usually a few changes to the first three touches.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound with three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Armando, last bit of proof for Trackforce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 600 replies and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other security-tech SDR teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Armando, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up and ramp without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A leadership change and growth push keep an SDR floor plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to Trackforce either way.
